note.ja: 心筋波の興奮・回復を表す現象論的な2変数モデル。単・双領域の組織モデルは追加の構成を要します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A reduced phenomenological excitation/recovery model for cardiac waves and restitution. Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model. Literature-only.
